newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy preliminary CPI figures due next week.
newsitem.headline: Italy preliminary CPI figures due next week.

text.p: Preliminary February consumer price indexes (CPI) from 11 Italian cities will be released next Thursday and Friday, statistics institute ISTAT said on Friday.
ISTAT said Milan, Genoa, Venice, Trieste, Bologna and Perugia would release their preliminary data on Thursday.
Turin, Florence, Naples, Bari and Palermo would issue their data on Friday. The figures will be released at 1630 GMT on both days.
The official national figure for February CPI will be released at 0800 GMT on March 4 -- Rome newsroom +396 678-2501
